## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the §6.3 **Replay / optional R1** procedure row —
   disposable source copy with prefix/head/derived-object inventory,
   provider/effect execution disabled with **independent** attempted-
   dispatch counters, exact declared decision/assembly and original-
   prefix agreement, permitted replay markers may append; R1 deletes
   required derived objects only in the copy and rederives each
   required hash from the authoritative prefix — plus the **Fresh /
   optional R2|R3** and **Independent replication/transfer** admission
   rows — inside `hh-bundle` (the recipient-procedure owner beside
   `closure.rs`/`repro.rs`/`levels.rs`; I-02 one home; records-in/
   records-out, no public RPC — C.4).
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.26.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results. Cards stay separate — `replay-card/1` /
   `fresh-card/1` records with `procedure`/`level` members;
   `prerequisites`/`resources` members are recorded separately and
   never folded into `verdict` (AC-1; §6.3 "keep … separate"; F1).
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.21
   `evidence-package/1`, R5.22 `closure_walk`/`closure_report`, R5.23
   `assemble_receipt`/`population-receipt/1`, R5.24 decode bounds + R0
   fold, R5.25 `recompute_analysis`/`analysis-recompute/1`, plus the
   landed `levels::derive` basis and `compute_independence` basis.
   A new shared/persisted decision lands in the owning ADR admission
   (landing-record ADR, ADR-0024 rung).

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): disposable copy + immutable original
  prefix verified; independent attempted-provider/effect counters
  prove R1 derivation with exact hashes and declared
  decisions/assembly; verify/recompute/replay/fresh/transfer cards
  and prerequisite/resource comparisons stay separate.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): missing response/definition, changed
  derivation, any attempted live dispatch, original mutation and
  replay-suffix confusion fail; retired model/missing
  seeds/MatchSpec/parity/floor blocks fresh claims; no funded
  replication and no independence from an author-only clean
  directory.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership and evidence): the five primary targets
  resolved to numbered checks + actual evidence in the coverage
  register; achieved D/E recorded separately from owed R/P or
  actual-execution E; R5.45 contributor evidence remains owed
  (evidence dependency, never dispatch dependency).
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression;
  fmt + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode per touch;
  scratch stores; exact commands + counts.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): green in scope; REQ ids
  stamped; DEFERRALS rows for owed legs; ADRs for owned decisions;
  run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; operating clauses.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-bundle/src/cards.rs` (new, ≈480 lines) — the §6.3
   isolated-replay and fresh-execution admission owner interfaces,
   records-in/records-out beside `closure.rs`:
   `admit_replay(&Decoded, run_id, &ReplayAttempt) ->
   Result<AdmissionCard, BundleError>` and
   `admit_fresh(&Decoded, run_id, &FreshClaim) ->
   Result<AdmissionCard, BundleError>`.
   - `ReplayAttempt{copy: Vec<EventEnvelope>, replayed_decisions,
     replayed_assembled, rederived: Vec<RederivedObject>, isolation:
     Isolation, claim_r1}` — the disposable copy's stream +
     re-drive emissions + the disabled-boundary isolation report;
     the card recounts appended attempt classes itself (independent
     counters — declared counts must agree, never trusted).
   - `admit_replay` legs: `inputs` (definition + compiled_bundle
     member bytes + recorded response rows + `control.decision`
     declaration + both isolation flags — missing → typed
     `CardRefused`) → `prefix` (source hash/chain recompute; copy
     prefix field-exact vs original envelopes — deviation or source
     corruption is `original_mutation`) → `suffix` (appended rows
     limited to `lifecycle.replay.*`, seq/prev_hash continuation,
     hashes recompute; provider `model.call.*` and effect
     `action.effect.*` classes counted → `attempted_live_dispatch`;
     other classes → `replay_suffix`) → `decisions`
     (replayed decision/assembly payload sequences equal the
     recorded `control.decision`/`context.assembled` sequences —
     `changed_derivation`) → `rederivation` (R1: required set
     `version_id` + envelope hashes + present member addresses +
     the run's ledger `tree`; each rederived hash recomputed from
     authoritative bytes — missing/mismatch/unknown fails).
   - `admit_fresh` gates (typed `CardRefused`): `unfunded`,
     `unavailable{model_retired}`, `not_fresh`,
     `charging_attribution`; R2 `unavailable{seeds|margins|
     validators}`; R3 `unavailable{seed_distribution|matchspec|
     margins|seeds}`; transfer `outside_relationship`,
     `no_new_phase`, `unavailable{comparison}`, `new_question`,
     `not_independent{basis}` via the landed
     `compute_independence`. Legs (fail rows → `not_admitted`):
     `native_basis` per-entry satisfaction through `levels::derive`
     (R2 set for R2/transfer, R3 set for R3) and `arms`
     (`planned_arms ≥ min_arms ≥ 2` — one fresh demo awards no
     level).
   - `AdmissionCard{schema, procedure, level, bundle_id, run_id,
     verdict{admitted|not_admitted}, failures[], legs{},
     prerequisites, resources, counters, independence, card_id}`
     — `idp/1` sealed like `ReproReport`; refusal codes a closed
     `cards::code` set on `BundleError::CardRefused`.
2. `crates/hh-bundle/src/error.rs` — `CardRefused{code, detail}`
   variant (+≈20); `lib.rs` — module + exports (+≈8).
3. `crates/hh-bundle/tests/r5_26.rs` (≈600 lines) — scratch-Store
   producer → `assemble` → `Decoded`; copy built as prefix +
   fabricated marker/attempt envelopes (hash chain minted via
   `recompute_hash`).
4. Build-memory records: this ledger, landing ADR-0404 +
   index/revisit-trigger regeneration (BL-47 home), dated coverage
   note, `docs/build/pr/R5.26.md`, closeout (BUILD_INDEX seq-196
   row, LEDGER advance, ci-boundary record).
